# cubepath_lb_plans (Data Source)

Fetches available load balancer plans.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `locations` (Attributes List) Plans grouped by location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Location description.
- `location_name` (String) Location identifier.
- `plans` (Attributes List) Available plans at this location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--locations--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations.plans`

Read-Only:

- `connections_per_second` (Number) Maximum connections per second.
- `max_listeners` (Number) Maximum number of listeners.
- `max_targets` (Number) Maximum number of targets.
- `name` (String) Plan name.
- `price_per_hour` (String) Price per hour.
